title: M9-C42.21 — Milestone M21.10 Forward Convergence Report
executive_summary: The authorized 12-component full mutation campaign has been executed with evidence completeness (not_checked=0 for all components). Population-weighted aggregate mutation score is 49.9% (4422/8862 scored), significantly below the 80% threshold. Four pilot engines reproduce exactly (credit_card 75.6%, account 89.1%, loan 84.0%, reconciliation 80.4%). Eight new components reveal systematic verification weaknesses: high coverage does not imply high mutation effectiveness. Two core components (transaction_intelligence, financial_intelligence) remain deferred behind test-strengthening gates. The verification architecture has mutation evidence ready but requires cross-layer unification, planner fail-safe hardening, CI gate enforcement, and historical intelligence before final self-verifying system certification.

full_mutation_evidence.campaign_scope: 12 authorized components, 11,730 mutants, sequential execution with --max-children 4, explicit --max-runtime per engine
full_mutation_evidence.population_reconciliation: actual population authoritative (11,730 vs 5,354 estimate); pilot controls 4/4 exact; loan variance 5/1273 mutants (0.39%) documented
key_findings: High coverage ≠ high mutation: 6 engines with >88% coverage have <60% mutation (cashflow 97.6%/29.1%, ledger_audit 93.5%/56.8%, recommendation 95.9%/57.8%, common_calculations 99.4%/56.4%, financial_events 88%/59%, behaviour 70.4%/26.7%)
Low coverage ≠ low mutation: balance_engine 58.9% coverage, 95.4% mutation (focused unit tests with strong assertions)
Discovery gaps: behaviour_engine 39% no_tests (2835 mutants), financial_events 4% no_tests (29 mutants) — coverage sees lines, mutation sees test-to-mutant binding
Property-test-only engines (cashflow) have inherent mutation discrimination limits
Equivalent mutants dominate in financial precision arithmetic (credit_card, common_calculations, core_domain_money)
